title: Force Fitness Instructor Officer (I) (LtCol to 2ndLt) FMOS, CG TECOM
raw_text:
1. MOS 0919, Force Fitness Instructor Officer (I) (LtCol to 2ndLt) FMOS, CG
TECOM

    a. Summary. Assist COs/OICs in development of unit physical training
programs that enable accomplishment of mission essential tasks. This
includes injury prevention and physical performance enhancement. Assist
individual Marines with physical training programs and provide assistance to
sports medicine providers in design and execution of fitness programs for
Marines returning to duty from injury or extended periods of limited duty.

       b.    Prerequisites

             (1) Must qualify first class PFT.

             (2) Must qualify first class on CFT.

             (3) Must have recommendation of reporting senior.

        (4) Full duty status: shoulder injury free in previous 2 years,
concussion free within the past 6 months and free of contagious diseases of
dermatological conditions.

       c.    Requirements

        (1) Complete the Force Fitness Instructor (FFI) Course (M02MN1T or
M02MN1M).

        (2) Complete the Physical Fitness Test Monitor Certification Course
(FFD01PFT02), the Combat Fitness Test Monitor Certification Course
(FFD02CFT02), and the Bod Composition Military Appearance Program Monitor
Certification Course (FFD03BCP02).

             (3) Approval of the commanding officer to whom assigned.

        (4) Any Marine officer who completed the Force Fitness Instructor
Course identified above, may be awarded this MOS upon presentation of a
completion certificate.

    d. Duties. For a partial listing of duties and tasks, refer to the
Training Military Occupational Specialties Training and Readiness Manual.
Otherwise, responsible to manage fitness, MCMAP, and Water Survival Programs,
as directed by unit commander.

    e.       Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
None.

       f.    Related Military Skill.   None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
